arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show line segment image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: lsd_refine_type
arg.description: Line Segment Detector Modes. 0: No refinement applied, 1: Standard refinement is applied, 2, Advanced refinement is applied.

arg.name: lsd_scale
arg.description: The scale of the image that will be used to find the lines. Range [0.1..1]

arg.name: lsd_sigma_scale
arg.description: Sigma for Gaussian filter. It is computed as sigma = _sigma_scale/_scale

arg.name: lsd_quant
arg.description: Bound to the quantization error on the gradient norm

arg.name: lsd_log_eps
arg.description: Detection threshold: -log10(NFA) > log_eps. Used only when advanced refinement is chosen

arg.name: lsd_density_threshold
arg.description: Minimal density of aligned region points in the enclosing rectangle

arg.name: lsd_n_bins
arg.description: Number of bins in pseudo-ordering of gradient modulus

arg.name: lsd_line_length_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of line length. Shorter lines are not published nor drawn.
